records.text: In August 2006 Erika Kirk won a National American Miss Teen title and traveled to Washington to present plans to Representative J. D. Hayworth and Senator Jon Kyl
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In August, just ahead of Erika (Erika Kirk)'s senior year, this is 2006 now, in August just ahead of her senior year, she's going to win the National American Miss Teen pageant and she wins a chance and takes it to travel to D.C. ... to present her plans to Representative J.D. Hayworth and Senator Jon Kyl.

verification.notes: Regis and current biographical sources support a National American Miss Teen Arizona title and a Presidential Classroom trip to Washington, D.C. However, current reporting places the title in 2007 rather than August 2006, and the reviewed sources do not confirm that her plans were personally presented to both J.D. Hayworth and Jon Kyl.
